_comment: Map catalog. Each cell in `grid` is a full Tile Palette instance — id, name, walkable, sprite, and any other tile fields are materialized inline. Painting a cell deep-copies the brush palette entry into that cell; editing a cell in the inspector mutates the cell directly. Palette edits do NOT auto-propagate to painted cells (the cell is its own data after paint) — repaint to refresh. `tags` group maps in the editor for organization; the linking system on tiles is independent of tags. The grid is row-major: grid[row][col].
